time_scale_model: UTC→TAI uses hifitime 4.3's pinned leap-second and historical UTC model; TAI−UTC is 37 s from 2017 under the pinned table (27 inserted leap seconds plus the initial 10 s). TAI→TT adds 32.184 s. TT→TDB adds the periodic relativistic term, bounded by approximately 1.7 ms. Historical proleptic UTC and future UTC follow this versioned model, not a live Earth-rotation observation. SPK interpolation is a function of TDB. Earth-rotation angles use the separately recorded delta-T model.
